newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven die in Colombia poolroom slaying.
newsitem.headline: Seven die in Colombia poolroom slaying.

text.p: A heavily-armed gang burst into a poolroom and shot seven young men to death in a squatters' community in northwest Colombia, police said on Sunday.

Witnesses told police six unidentified gunmen forced their victims, between 16 to 25 years old, to lie face down on the floor before shooting them late on Saturday near the town of Bello in Antioquia province.

"We're still investigating the motives for this killing. Six people arrived at the poolroom and forced these young men to lie down before shooting them indiscriminately," a police spokesman in the nearby city of Medellin said.
In a separate incident in the town of Mocoa, in southern Putumayo province, two policemen were shot to death in a nightclub, authorities said.
